title.narrative: Engaging With Emerging Armed Groups to Enhance the Protection of Women, Children and Minorities in Myanmar

description.narrative: Contract related to: Engaging With Emerging Armed Groups to Enhance the Protection of Women, Children and Minorities in Myanmar - The proposed 18-month action aims to increase compliance with international humanitarian law (IHL) among emerging armed actors in Myanmar and contribute to the protection of human security and vulnerable conflict-affected civilians, in particular women, children and minorities. Specifically, the action will seek to increase awareness and knowledge of IHL obligations and support their implementation, and to strengthen community monitoring networks to advocate for the respect of humanitarian norms.
